candidate.name: Alameda County CalFresh (apply online via BenefitsCal, phone, mail or in person)
candidate.description: Apply for CalFresh online at BenefitsCal, by phone, or by mail. A household with no income may qualify for expedited service, with benefits within 3 calendar days of the county receiving the application. Ask for expedited processing when applying. Regular applications are processed within 30 days.

candidate.who_it_serves: Alameda County residents with low or no income
candidate.intake_requirements: Apply now with state ID; give the SSN if known. The SSN card replacement does not have to be finished before applying. Confirm office address and hours with the county before going in person.
candidate.reason: Marcus lives in Oakland, in Alameda County, and has $0 monthly income in a 1-person household. That matches who the listing serves: Alameda County residents with low or no income. With no income, he may qualify for expedited benefits within 3 days, so he should ask for expedited processing. He can apply with his state ID. The listing says he doesn't need to finish replacing his SSN card before applying. His property offense doesn't exclude him from CalFresh. Since he has a 9pm curfew, he can apply online through BenefitsCal or by phone.
candidate.rule_cited: Program listing: 'Alameda County residents with low or no income'; 'Apply now with state ID... SSN card replacement does not have to be finished before applying.'
